summary: Describes the Eifel detection algorithm, which lets a TCP sender work out after the fact that it started loss recovery unnecessarily, for example after a spurious timeout. It relies on the TCP Timestamps option. It is an experimental specification.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a package is only late, but the sender thinks it is lost and sends it again. This memo gives the sender a way to notice afterward that it worried for nothing, using time stamps on the packets.

questions: how to detect spurious tcp retransmission
